Operations.Name: KerberosKeytabCreate
Operations.Description:
Create a kerberos keytab. Uploaded keytab files will be merged with the system
keytab under /etc/krb5.keytab.

`file` b64encoded kerberos keytab
`name` name for kerberos keytab

Arguments.Name: data
Arguments.Description: Kerberos keytab configuration data for creation.

Operations.Name: KerberosKeytabDelete
Operations.Description:
Delete kerberos keytab by id, and force regeneration of
system keytab.

Arguments.Name: id
Arguments.Description: ID of the Kerberos keytab entry to delete.
